criteria.label: Price
criteria.description: Total cost for the quoted scope. Scored relative to the other quotes in this batch — the cheapest scores 100 — because a price has no absolute meaning without a benchmark.

criteria.label: Response time (SLA)
criteria.description: How quickly the supplier attends site. The biggest differentiator between two otherwise similar maintenance quotes.

criteria.label: Mobilisation time
criteria.description: How long until work can start once instructed.

criteria.label: Accreditations
criteria.description: Licences and certifications held, against what the RFQ requires. Missing a required one caps the score, because the work may not lawfully proceed.

criteria.label: Payment terms
criteria.description: How long the buyer has to pay. Longer is better for cash flow.

criteria.label: Minimum callout / order
criteria.description: The smallest job or order the supplier will accept, relative to what is being asked for.

criteria.label: Rate validity
criteria.description: How long the quoted rates hold before they must be re-quoted.

criteria.label: Defect liability
criteria.description: The period during which the supplier must rectify defects at their own cost.

criteria.label: Supplier risk
criteria.description: Your own risk rating for the supplier. More weight here means insurance, safety record and references count for more than price.
